purpose: Single character palette reference for future native 48x64 redraw. This is a design map, not automatic quantization.
construction_rules: Use 1 almost-black color for outline and cuts.
Use 2 tones for hair/metal/dark material where possible.
Use 1-2 accent colors for lava/armband/gold/eyes as needed.
Prefer harmony and contrast over maximizing color count.
Do not rely on middle-tone colors that vanish in RGB 3:3:3.

locked_material_rules.lava_arm_and_hand: Always exposed rock fist/hand with dark outline and orange/red crack accents. Never wrap/glove/bandage.
locked_material_rules.red_armband: Non-lava biceps only, consistent in every applicable pose.

optional_fx_palette_note: Detached fire/impact FX may use a separate PAL3 strip after body source approval. Do not bake FX into the character body sheet.
